[BBC Business] Jobless rate falls but small firms cut back hiring

[BBC Business] Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget

Investors will be looking for updates on Netflix's ad-supported business, engagement metrics and how the streaming giant continues to view potential M&A.

[MarketWatch] It’s not just California’s billionaire tax. Wealth is on the ballot in the midterm elections.
Several states are dealing with ballot measures tied to taxing the rich — and there may be even more initiatives on this front in 2028.
